{{Quote|I told Nattis&mdash;the Republic's our priority, and we're already shorthanded. We just&mdash;please excuse me. I have a team reporting in.|Master Sergeant Hayg|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Hayg''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Hayg was stationed at the [[deep launchpoint transfer]] far into [[the Tomb]]. After the [[Esh-kha]] used experimental weapons to wipe out an Imperial unit, [[Specialist/Legends|Specialist]] [[Nattis]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] tried to convince Hayg to divert forces and destroy the weapons, but Hayg was shorthanded and did not take the threat seriously. Nattis was forced to recruit other Imperials in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Sergeant Hayg appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he and Nattis provide Imperial players with the mission "Found in Translation."<ref name="TOR" />
